browse.books_empty: No books in this series yet.
browse.series_empty: No series in this library yet.

connection.unexpected_answer: The server's answer doesn't make sense to the app. Updating the app may help.
connection.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check the address and your connection.

errors.directory_not_found: There's no folder at this path on the server.
errors.directory_overlaps: This folder lies inside a folder the server already uses, or contains one.
errors.directory_taken: This folder has already been added.
errors.email_not_configured: This server can't send email yet. Ask its admin to set it up.
errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email address first, with the code we sent you.
errors.email_taken: This email address is already in use.
errors.email_unchanged: This is already your email address.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.incorrect_credentials: Wrong username, email address or password.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again later.
errors.invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address.
errors.invalid_or_expired_code: This code is wrong or has expired.
errors.invalid_reading_mode: This reading mode doesn't exist. Updating the app may help.
errors.invalid_release_years: The release years don't fit: each from 1 to 9999, and the first not after the last.
errors.invalid_request: The server couldn't read this request. Updating the app may help.
errors.invalid_setup_code: The setup code is wrong. You find it in the server's log.
errors.last_admin: The last admin can't become a member.
errors.method_not_allowed: The server doesn't support this here.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password is the same as the current one.
errors.scan_in_progress: A scan is already running or waiting. Try again once it has finished.
errors.series_not_empty: This series still has books, so it can't be deleted.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.totp_setup_not_pending: There's no two-factor setup to confirm. Start the setup again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

home.empty: No libraries yet. They appear once an admin scans the book folders.
home.title: Libraries

login_code.app_explanation: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_code.recovery_explanation: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each one works once.
login_code.title: Two-factor authentication

manage.delete_library_explanation: Its series and books stay, and so do the files.
manage.delete_series_explanation: Only a series without books can be deleted.
manage.folder_path_help: Its full path, as the server sees it, such as /Users/you/Books.
manage.folder_scanned: Once added, the server reads the folder in the background, and its books appear as it goes.
manage.folders_empty: There are no folders yet. Add the one your books are in.
manage.merge_series_explanation: Its books, libraries and reading modes move to {name}, and so do books found under its name later. This series is then deleted; the files stay as they are.
manage.name: Name
manage.no_merge_target: There is no other series to merge into.
manage.own_library: Give it a library of its own
manage.own_library_off: Its series wait in no library until you add them to one.
manage.own_library_on: A new library receives its series.
manage.remove_folder_explanation: Its books leave the catalog, and so do the series left without books. The files stay on the server, and so does its library.
manage.series_empty: There are no series yet. A scan finds them in the server's folders.
manage.title: Manage

password_reset.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
password_reset.explanation: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a code to set a new password.
password_reset.new_explanation: If an account uses this address, a code is on its way. Enter it with your new password.
password_reset.title: Reset your password

reader.mode_not_saved: The reading mode couldn't be saved.
reader.unsupported: The app can't show this kind of book yet.

server.insecure_address: Use an address that starts with https://.
server.invalid_address: This doesn't look like a server address.
server.not_a_bookserver: There's no book server at this address.
server.title: Connect to your book server

settings.device_language_explanation: Follows your device's language where the server offers it.
settings.title: Settings

sign_up.setup_code_explanation: The server's first account becomes its admin and needs the setup code from the server's start log.
sign_up.title: Create an account
sign_up.username_rule: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

two_factor.code_or_recovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code
two_factor.codes_explanation: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe: they're shown only now.
two_factor.explanation_off: Off. Turn it on to sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
two_factor.no_app: No authenticator app on this device opened the link. Enter the setup key there instead.
two_factor.off_done: Two-factor authentication is off. Sign in again.
two_factor.off_explanation: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. Turning it off signs you out everywhere.
two_factor.renew_explanation: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. The old recovery codes stop working.
two_factor.setup_explanation: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key there. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication

verify_email.explanation: We sent a code to your email address. Enter it here to finish setting up your account.
verify_email.resent: If the account still waits for its code, a new one is on its way.
verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
